$comment: Recordings chosen from the Sonniss GDC 2026 Game Audio Bundle (Part 9) and how each game sound is cut from them. Read by scripts/audio/extract-sonniss.mjs. Times are seconds in the source recording; 'take' is a 1-based index into the separate takes found at the source's 'takes' settings, measured from the take's start or, with anchor 'peak', from its loudest moment. 'peakIn': [a, b] cuts 'length' seconds starting 'from' seconds (default -0.005, a 5 ms lead-in) relative to the loudest sample between a and b, so an impact lands at the start of the sound. 'pitch' is in semitones (by resampling, so it also changes the length). 'decay' shapes a layer to fall 20 dB every that many seconds from its start, so its first hit stays the loudest. Layers are mixed at 'offset' seconds. Each output's level is set by its variation pool in lib/pools.mjs, if it has one.
